theorems.name: Submission.lpf_c1r_egoroff_closed
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (Eucl n)) (f : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ), MeasurableSet C → (∀ k, Measurable (f k)) → Measurable g → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => f k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed A ∧ A ⊆ C ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop (A ∩ closedBall 0 R)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
